exposure: one abnormal value (OAV) in the oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent an OGTT between 24 and 28 weeks and delivered at term (>37 weeks)
finding: Women with GDMA2 (GDM treated with insulin) had higher rates of cesarean delivery and adverse neonatal outcomes compared to women with GDMA1 (GDM controlled with diet) and OAV, while the OAV and GDMA1 groups had higher rates of fetal vascular malperfusion lesions compared to the GDMA2 group.
mod_finding: GDMA2 was associated with an increased rate of cesarean delivery compared to GDMA1 and OAV.
